# MedReg Consultancy LLP

> MedReg Consultancy LLP is a medical device and IVD regulatory consulting firm headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Since 2011 it has completed 2,000+ regulatory projects for 950+ clients across 20+ countries, covering CDSCO licensing in India, CE marking under EU MDR 2017/745 and IVDR 2017/746, US FDA 510(k) and QMSR, MDSAP, ISO 13485:2016 and global country registrations.

Key facts:
- Legal name: Medreg Consultancy LLP (brand: MedReg). Tagline: "Let's Decode The Regulations".
- Founded: 2011. Headquarters: 11th Floor, Block C – 1105/1106, Titanium Business Park, Behind Divya Bhaskar Press, Near Makarba Railway Crossing, Makarba, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380051, India.
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 88664 61989, +91 63523 88194. Email: info@medreg.in (general), bdm@medreg.in (business development).
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM IST.
- Clients: medical device and IVD manufacturers, importers and distributors — from startups to multinationals — for Class A/B/C/D (India), Class I/IIa/IIb/III (EU) and Class I/II (US) devices.
- Device expertise: surgical disposables, catheters, orthopaedic and spinal implants, sutures and meshes, IVD reagents, laparoscopic and endoscopic instruments, active and electromechanical devices.

## Services by market

- [India — CDSCO regulatory services](https://medreg.in/india/): Medical Device Rules 2017; manufacturing licences (MD-3/MD-5 for Class A/B via State Licensing Authority, MD-7/MD-9 for Class C/D via Central Licensing Authority); import licence (MD-14 application, MD-15 licence); clinical investigations; Free Sale, Market Standing and Non-Conviction certificates; Rule 44 labelling review; Indian Authorized Agent; wholesale licence (MD-41/MD-42); Device and Plant Master Files; Fifth Schedule QMS.
- [Europe — CE marking under EU MDR / IVDR](https://medreg.in/europe/): Annex II/III technical documentation; MDD-to-MDR gap analysis; clinical evaluation (CEP/CER); GSPR checklist (Annex I); PMS, PSUR and PMCF; ISO 14971 risk management; PRRC support (Article 15); classification under Annex VIII; European Authorized Representative via partners.
- [USA — US FDA](https://medreg.in/usa/): 510(k) (Traditional, Special, Abbreviated) via eSTAR; Q-Submission / Pre-Sub; establishment registration and device listing; GUDID/UDI; QMSR (21 CFR Part 820) implementation; Small Business Determination (reduced user fees); US Agent; FDA Form 483 responses; complaint files and MDR (21 CFR 803).
- [Global markets — MDSAP, ISO 13485 and registrations](https://medreg.in/other-services/): MDSAP (USA, Canada, Brazil, Japan, Australia); ISO 13485:2016 QMS implementation and audits; IMDRF/STED technical files; registrations with ANVISA, TGA, Health Canada, SFDA, SAHPRA and UKCA; process validation (IQ/OQ/PQ); sterilisation validation; biological evaluation (BEP/BER, ISO 10993).
